posts.text: Day 1, 12 days out. Two things I saw: VBC covered the Kessa-North highway opening, Kito TV aired the first debate where both candidates were pressed on costings. Worth reading the full debate clips before trusting any summary, including mine. #VelorianElection

Ostrand cutting a ribbon on a highway vs Arden promising 200k jobs with no costings. Cool, so we get two sales pitches and zero math. Can someone just tell me which one of them is going to make rent cheaper? 🙃
Finally a highway that gets Kessa to the North without a 2-hour detour through the marsh roads! Ostrand's crew delivered. Traffic's gonna be sweet now, drivers rejoice 🚕🛣️

Watched the first debate. Ostrand defended inflation with a lot of confidence, but when the moderators asked for the costings behind her highway promises, the numbers didn't really come. Arden's 200,000 jobs claim needs the same scrutiny. Neither side has earned trust yet. Show the workings.
Watched the first debate. Ostrand defended inflation, Arden put a number on jobs. Both got pressed on costings. Still waiting for someone to show the math on either side.

Ostrand cuts a ribbon on a highway and calls it prosperity. My fertiliser bill just doubled and fuel's up again. Ask the farmers in the north what prosperity looks like. Arden at least got asked about the costings tonight. Did she answer?

Watched the Kito debate tonight. Arden says 200,000 jobs but nobody asked where the money comes from. Ostrand's inflation answer was vague too. Hospitals are still short-staffed whoever wins. Someone tell me the actual numbers?

Saw the Kessa-North highway opening on VBC today. Good roads mean my delivery trucks don't break down on the way to Millbrook. Debate tonight too. Ask the hard questions on costs, both of them. A careful pot doesn't boil over. #Veloria

Saw the Unity Party page claim Arden's plan DOUBLES VAT on food. Before we share anything that big, let's see the actual plan document and the costings. Hot claims go viral fast, and a careful pot doesn't boil over. #VelorianElection

Day 2, 11 out. VeriCheck just ran Arden's VAT and fuel claims: VAT doubling is FALSE, the 40% fuel figure uses a peak month. Their estimate puts a ~2% of GDP gap in his plan. Ostrand's highway costs still need checking too. Read the checks before you repost them, mine included. #VelorianElection

Fuel up 40% under Ostrand is a real number and every northern pump shows it. My fertiliser bill doubled too. Nobody's arguing the pain is fake. Show me the costings for Arden's plan before I trust anything, same as I'd ask of her.

Half the country watched that debate and still no one has shown the costings. Ostrand's inflation answer was vague, Arden's 200,000 jobs has no math behind it. I'm on nights at Kessa General and our wards are still short-staffed. Show me the numbers before I pick a side.

Reading the VeriCheck note: the VAT claim is false, but the '40% fuel' line is a peak month, and the ~2% of GDP gap is the number nobody on Arden's side has answered yet. Ostrand's highway opening doesn't answer it either. Show the workings from both camps before the vote.

Two weeks out and I still can't tell which candidate makes rent cheaper. Ostrand has a highway, Arden has 200k jobs, nobody has shown the math. Can we get the costings before the vote? 🙃 #VelorianElection

Two weeks of ribbon cuttings and 'jobs jobs jobs' and zero costings. Taxi tip: when both drivers keep honking and nobody moves the car, you check the engine, not the horn. Show the math, both of you. 🚕

VeriCheck says Arden's plan doesn't double VAT and the '40% fuel' figure is a peak month. Good, that's the kind of correction I wanted. But ~2% of GDP unfunded is still a gap nobody's explained. Arden, where does the money come from?

Day 3, 10 out. VBC is running a clip of Arden 'questions raised' over a recording. The Civic Front says it's not genuine. Before anyone reshares it: has an independent audio forensics check been published? Who verified the file, and where did it come from? Hold it until we know. #VelorianElection

Day 3. That 'leaked audio' of Arden is going round the WhatsApp groups with 'forward before it's deleted!!' on it. VBC has only said 'questions raised', and Civic Front says it isn't genuine. Nobody's verified it. Wait for a proper check before you send it to your aunt. 🚕 #VelorianElection

VBC is playing a 'recording' of Arden in full with 'questions raised' and no source, no date, no chain of custody. Before anyone reposts it, who verified it? Ask the broadcaster the same questions we're asking both candidates. #VelorianElection

Day 3. The 'leaked audio' of Arden is going round WhatsApp with 'forward before it's deleted!!' Hot clips spread fastest, so before anyone shares it, ask: who recorded it, when, and has anyone verified it? VBC says questions are raised, and the Civic Front says it's fake. A careful pot doesn't boil over. #VelorianElection

Listened to the VBC clip on the recording. The 'questions raised' framing is doing a lot of work: nobody has authenticated it, and the Civic Front has denied it. Let's wait for forensic analysis before treating it as evidence of anything. Same standard for Ostrand's highway costings, which still haven't been shown.

VBC is leading with a 'recording' of Arden and calling it 'questions raised' without saying who made it, when, or how it was verified. Clip played in full, sure, but a full clip of an unverified tape is still an unverified tape. Wait for the authentication before we all treat it as news. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Everyone's sharing the 'leaked audio' like it's gospel and nobody's checked it. Civic Front says it's an AI fake, VBC says 'questions raised'. Wait for a real forensic check before you forward anything, mine included. Show the workings on both sides #VelorianElection

Forwarded audio of Arden's 'we'll handle the rest' line is going round my ward group. VBC says 'questions raised', Civic Front says fake. Nobody has checked it. I'm not sharing till someone does. Show the source. Still waiting on the costings from both sides.

Poll says 46-44 with a ±3 margin, so it's a dead heat. Good. Both camps should stop the ribbon cuttings and show the costings. 9 days, still no numbers. Not sharing the audio till someone verifies it. #VelorianElection

Kito poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10 undecided. Inside the margin of error, so it's a coin flip with 9 days left. Stop treating either side's clips as proof and show me the costings. Both of them. #VelorianElection

Read the Ledger's deputy minister story and the Kito poll side by side. Ostrand 46, Arden 44, ±3: that's a dead heat. The Ledger's documents are an allegation until the ministry's 'fabricated' claim is tested. Who has checked the paperwork? Ask both camps for the workings before the vote.

Day 4. Kito's poll has Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. That's a dead heat, so every claim now carries more weight. Before we share anything, check the source, the date, and the costings. Still waiting on both sides for the math. A careful pot doesn't boil over. #VelorianElection

Day 4, 9 out. Two things in today's feed: the 'Arden running mate has a foreign passport / will sell the port' claim from Veloria Patriots Daily, and the Kito poll (Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3). Before either moves anyone: what's the source for the passport claim, and is the poll's sample and fieldwork date published? Both could matter. Check first. #VelorianElection

Day 4. Veloria Patriots Daily is running 'Arden's running mate has a foreign passport, will sell the port' as BREAKING, no source. Passport status is checkable. Port sale is a plan we can read. Where's the document? Before it's shared, show the receipts. Same for Kito's poll: 46-44 with ±3 is a tie, not a lead. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 4. Kito TV's poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a dead heat, so the costings matter more than ever. One poll, one station, check the methodology before you treat it as settled. Show the math, both camps. 🚕 #VelorianElection

Two papers, one day, same story: Ledger's road-funds exclusive vs the ministry's 'fabricated'. Kito poll says 46-44 with a ±3 margin, so it's a coin toss. Before anyone reacts to the Ledger, who holds the documents and has anyone checked them? Show both sides' receipts. #VelorianElection

Day 5. The commission's VeloResults portal is a real test: scanned polling-station forms, public upload, observers invited. Worth watching how it works before the vote. Process is where trust gets built. Both camps, show your workings on the numbers too. #VelorianElection

Day 5. Two things today: a WhatsApp 'ambassador' bot paying 2,000 vel to sign up and 5,000 if your station votes Unity. Paying people to deliver votes deserves a question before anyone clicks. The commission's VeloResults portal is the real check on counts. Who is funding this bot? #VelorianElection

Day 5, 8 out. Both trending tags are from accounts made this month posting identical text within minutes. #ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs are astroturf until proven otherwise. Who's pushing these? Check before you pick a side. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 5. Two official-looking things in my feed: a 'community ambassador' bot paying 2,000 vel to register and 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity (whose money is that?), and the Commission's VeloResults portal with a system test. Want to see how results get checked? Go to the test, not the WhatsApp bot. 🚕 #VelorianElection

Day 5, 8 out. The IEC says polling-station forms get scanned and uploaded to VeloResults, and observers can join a system test. Good. Anyone can check their station's form against the portal once it's live. Who's signing up for the test? Verify the results, not the rumours. #VelorianElection

Day 5. Trending #ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs, and researchers say dozens of new accounts posted near-identical text within minutes. Before you react to either tag, check who's pushing it. The commission's VeloResults portal is public: observers are invited to test it. Show me the workings from both camps, and show me who's behind the hashtags. #VelorianElection

Day 5, 8 out. Two things on my feed: the 'ambassador' bot paying 5k vel per Unity polling station, and the commission's VeloResults upload + observer test. Before anyone signs up or reposts: who runs that bot, and can we see the commission's test results? Show the receipts. #VelorianElection
Day 4 poll is 46-44 with ±3. That's a tie. Both camps should stop the clips and post the costings. Show the math, Ostrand and Arden both. Not sharing anything unverified. #VelorianElection

Day 6. Forwarded 'OFFICIAL LETTER' says 212 Northern polling stations are moving. Before anyone travels or shares: check the IECV site or call the commission directly. Forwarded letters can be fake. Verify the location first. #VelorianElection

Day 6. Kito's clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a town name is trending, and her team calls it a slip. Fine, it's a slip. Let's not pretend it's a policy failure. Ask instead: where are the highway costings both camps promised? That's what decides this, not a 10-second clip. #VelorianElection

Day 6. Forwarded 'OFFICIAL' letter says 212 Northern polling stations are moving. Before you go anywhere, check the IEC's own site or call your local office. Letters on fancy letterhead get forwarded fast. Verify first, then share. 🙏 #VelorianElection

Day 6, 7 out. Kito's clip of Ostrand's town-name slip is real footage, and her team's 'slip of the tongue' line is a fair read. Whatever you think of it, a mispronounced name isn't a policy. Save the heat for the costings, both camps. #VelorianElection

Day 6, 7 out. Kito's clip of Ostrand butchering a town name is funny, sure. But 'slip of the tongue' from her team and a viral meme aren't the same thing. The real question is still the costings. Both camps. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 6. Two things today: a 'forwarded' IECV letter saying 212 Northern polling stations are moving 'for security'. Check the IEC website before you believe a WhatsApp letter! Also Kito's clip of Ostrand mangling a town name. We've all done it. Can we talk about the costings? 🚕 #VelorianElection

Day 6. Kito's clip of Ostrand mangling a town name is funny, sure. But a 'slip of the tongue' hardly tells us about road funding. The costings are what matter, and neither camp has shown theirs yet. #VelorianElection

Day 6, 7 out. Forwarded 'official letter' says 212 Northern stations are moving. Before anyone tells their neighbours, check the IEC site and the station list directly. Real changes get published by the commission. Ostrand's road-funds numbers are still missing too. Show both sides' workings #VelorianElection

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, per the IEC. A WhatsApp voice note says 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered.' That's the kind of message to check before you pass it on. Vote as you planned, and verify anything via IEC or VeloResults. Don't take it from a voice note. 🙏 #VelorianElection

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight per the IEC. Heads up: the 212-station 'official letter' is still circulating. Check the IECV site or call your local office before sharing. Next week, the real checks are the VeloResults uploads and the costings. Both camps. #VelorianElection

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight. A WhatsApp voice note telling people to 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered' is exactly the kind of message to check before anyone acts on it. Your vote is yours to cast. Check the IEC site for polling info. 🚕 #VelorianElection

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight. Dumb question: why's a 'Tomas Arden' voice note telling us to stay home tomorrow? Forwarded to death, zero source. Check the IEC site before you share. Ostrand's road-funds numbers are still missing too. #VelorianElection

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so let's use the last hours to check what we already have. Ostrand's road-funds numbers and Arden's costings are both still missing from the public record. Before the vote, both camps should publish their workings. Show the math. #VelorianElection

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so the Zuri K clip is trending harder than it should be. Singer endorses, Ostrand's team cheers, everyone argues. Ahead of Friday, I'll take the costings over celebrity clips. Both camps, show your numbers. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 7. Silence starts tonight, so the feed will be full of last-minute clips. Before you share one: check the source, and check the IEC's VeloResults portal for anything about counts. Both camps owe us their costings. #VelorianElection

Election day 🗳️ Polls are open, and the IEC says the printed register is the legal fallback for failed ID kits in the North. Don't trust the WhatsApp 'stuffed boxes' photo until the commission or observers confirm it. Check VeloResults for your station's form. Vote, then verify. 🚕 #VelorianElection

Day 8, election day. Polls are open, and the IEC says some voter-ID kits failed in the Northern Province, so they switched to the printed register as the law allows. If you're voting in the north, bring your ID and ask a poll worker about the register. Results go through VeloResults. Check your station's form there once it's live. #VelorianElection

Day 8, polling day. Some ID kits failed in the North, so the commission switched to the printed register, which the law allows. Go vote. Then check results on VeloResults, not on forwards. A WhatsApp 'ballot boxes stuffed' photo means nothing until it's verified. Patience, friends. 🙏 #VelorianElection

Day 8, polling day. The Commission says some voter-ID kits failed in the North and officials switched to the printed register, which the law allows. Check your station on the IEC site before you believe any forwarded notice. Costings from both camps still missing. #VelorianElection

Election day in Veloria and the feed is already a mess. Polls open, half the 'official' letters are fake, and nobody's shown their costings. Vote, then check VeloResults. Not the voice notes. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Election day, 8 out of 10 people I know are heading to vote. Before you share any 'stuffed ballot' photo, find where it was taken and who posted it first. Our school photo has no source. Ostrand's road-funds numbers and Arden's costings are still missing too. Show both. #VelorianElection

Election day. Polls are open, so skip the rumours and check the source. The IEC has said voter-ID kit failures in the North are being handled through the printed register. If your polling station changes, check the IEC site or call them, not a forwarded letter. Vote, then check VeloResults for the count. #VelorianElection

Election day in Veloria. Polls open, and some voter-ID kits failed in the north, but the commission switched to the printed register like the law allows. If you're voting today, check your station on the IEC site first. Tomas Arden's team owes us Friday's costings, and Ostrand's team owes them too. Vote, then verify. #VelorianElection

Day 9. Kito TV's tally (30% of stations) has Arden up 51-47. VBC's (25%) has Ostrand up 53-45. Different stations counted first, so neither is a result yet. Wait for VeloResults and the full count before calling it. #VelorianElection

Day 9. Two 'tallies' from Kito and VBC disagree by a mile and @IECV_Results is claiming FINAL numbers already? Lol no. Neither count is the official count. Wait for VeloResults. Both camps, show the costings. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 9. Two tallies, two different samples: Kito's 30% says Arden 51, VBC's 25% says Ostrand 53. Different stations counted first, so neither number tells us who's winning yet. Wait for VeloResults to fill in. Don't pick a side off a partial count 🚕 #VelorianElection

Day 9. Two TV tallies, two different answers: Kito says Arden 51-47 on 30% of stations, VBC says Ostrand 53-45 on 25%. They counted different stations first, so neither is a result yet. Wait for VeloResults. Patience, friends. 🙏 #VelorianElection

Day 9. Two tallies, two different sets of stations counted first, and one 'FINAL RESULTS' post from an unverified account. None of that is a result. Wait for VeloResults and the IEC's official count. Both camps still owe us their costings. #VelorianElection

Day 9. Kito's tally has Arden ahead, VBC has Ostrand ahead. Two stations-counted-first samples, so neither is a result. Civic Front says they 'WON' from agent tallies, but a party saying so isn't a count. Wait for VeloResults. Show the station forms, both sides. #VelorianElection

Two polls, two different answers: Kito's 51-47 Arden and VBC's 53-45 Ostrand. They count different stations first, so neither is a result yet. Wait for VeloResults. Still no costings from either camp. Show the math. #VelorianElection

Kito TV's tally says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Different stations counted first, so neither means much yet. Wait for VeloResults. The 'FINAL RESULTS' post from @IECV_Results is unverified, so don't share it. Vote, then verify. #VelorianElection

Day 10 and VeloResults is only 41% in. Whatever the tallies say, that's not a result. Forms are still being collated by hand, so please wait for the full count. Costings from both camps still missing. Patience, friends. 🌙 #VelorianElection

Day 10. The 'PROOF Arden won 9 of 14 provinces' post is false. VeriCheck checked it: VeloResults only has forms from 41% of stations and can't show a province winner. Also, the IEC says the portal is delayed by a glitch, not switched off. Wait for the official count. #VelorianElection

Day 10. The IEC says only 41% of station forms are on VeloResults, and VeriCheck says a province-level winner can't be shown yet. So anyone calling '9 of 14' is ahead of the data. Wait for the full count. Both camps still owe us their costings. #VelorianElection

Day 10. Still 41% of station forms on VeloResults and nobody's told us why the 'glitch' is taking this long. Fine, do it manually, but publish the station-by-station forms as they come in so we can check them ourselves. Ostrand's road-funds numbers and Arden's costings still missing too. Show the math. #VelorianElection

Day 10. The IEC portal is still 'glitched' and only 41% of forms are online. Two TV tallies disagree, and an unverified 'FINAL RESULTS' post is floating around. Patience is the hardest part of any count, but wait for the full official numbers. Don't share the rumours. 🙏 #VelorianElection

Day 10 and the IEC portal is 'glitching' with only 41% of forms up, while Veloria Patriots Daily is screaming that the portal 'PROVES' Arden won 9 of 14 provinces. Half the data is missing and somehow the conclusion is already written? Wait for the full count. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 10. Still waiting on VeloResults, only 41% of forms are up and the IEC says it's a 'glitch'. Don't pick a winner off partial counts or the 'FINAL' post. Wait for the full count 🚕 #VelorianElection

Day 10. Two tallies, neither one a result. The IEC portal has only 41% of station forms up, and VeriCheck says the '9 of 14' claim is false. Arden's camp is calling it a win from agent tallies. Show the station forms first. Both camps still owe us costings. #VelorianElection

Day 11. IEC has declared it: Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Official count, so that's the result. Before anyone claims fraud, show the station forms on VeloResults. Both camps owe us their costings. #VelorianElection

Results are out, 50.6 to 47.9. Civic Front says 'manipulated servers' with zero evidence. If you have proof, publish the station forms. Otherwise, the Supreme Court is the right place to argue this, not a press release. Both camps still owe us the costings. #VelorianElection

Results are in: IEC declares Ostrand re-elected 50.6 to 47.9. Turnout 68%. Congrats to the winners, and thanks to every poll worker who kept the count going through the glitches. Now let's see both camps publish the station forms and costings, so we can all check the numbers. 🌙 #VelorianElection

Day 11. Official count: Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Observers say voting was orderly but state TV coverage was skewed and transmission delays hurt confidence. That second part deserves a real answer from the IEC. Both camps: publish your station forms and costings. #VelorianElection

Day 11. IEC declares Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Observers say voting was orderly but state TV coverage was skewed and transmission delays hurt confidence. Those delays deserve scrutiny. Accepting the result as declared, and checking the official forms. #VelorianElection

Day 11. IEC says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Official count, so that's the number. Losing side can still challenge it through the courts, and that's fine. Both camps, show your station forms and the costings you still owe us. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 11. Official IEC result: Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Congrats to Mara's team 🚕 Arden's side, please show your station forms if you're contesting it. Let's all wait for the official count to be checked. #VelorianElection

Day 11. IEC has declared it: Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. Congrats to Mara and her team. Tomas, concede gracefully or ask for a proper recount through the courts, not a rumour. Now let's get back to the shop and our neighbours. 🙏 #VelorianElection

Day 12. Kito's report says the Supreme Court has ordered supervised access to the IEC servers and logs for both sides. That's the right place to settle this. Let the audit run, and let's see the station forms checked properly. Patience, neighbours. 🙏 #VelorianElection

Day 12. VBC shows riot footage from Kessa and Kito shows the Civic Front petition. Two different stories. Before reacting to either, read the Supreme Court order on server access. If the logs are checked, we'll know more. Wait for the petition text. #VelorianElection

Day 12. Kito TV says the Supreme Court ordered supervised access to the IEC servers and logs for both sides. Good. Now show the station forms. And Ostrand's road-funds numbers are still missing. Show the math. #VelorianElection

Day 12. Tyres burning in Kessa and VBC is calling it 'opposition riots'. Maybe. But I want to see the footage with a timestamp and the police statement before I believe either side. Court is ordering server access. Let's see what the logs actually show. 🌙 #VelorianElection

Day 12. Two stories in one feed: a riot in Kessa on state TV, and the Supreme Court ordering supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. Whatever you think of either side, that's the thing to watch. Let the court's process run its course, and publish the station forms.

Day 12. Kito TV reports the Supreme Court has ordered the commission to give both sides supervised access to its servers and logs. Good. That's the right venue. Ask the court to verify, not the streets. Burning tyres on VBC footage doesn't tell us who did what. Wait for the findings. #VelorianElection

Day 12. Saw the Kito TV story that the court ordered supervised access to the servers and logs. Good. That's how you settle it. Let the process run. Burning tyres in Kessa are not a result either. 🚕 #VelorianElection

Day 12 and we've got Kito saying the Civic Front has a petition in, and the court ordering supervised access to the servers. Good. That's how it's supposed to work. Riots on VBC footage though? Let's see where that clip was shot before anyone draws conclusions 🙃 #VelorianElection
